mentions.note: won the 1950 International Cross-Country Race and the 3 miles at the 1950 A.A.A. Championships

photos.c: The International Cross-Country Race 1950 style. Lucien Theys of Belgium (centre) was the eventual winner and Alain Mimoun of France (right) was 2nd. An estimated 20,000 spectators turned up to watch the race, held in Brussels. Photo from World Sports.
